summary: v11.0.14.01 Enterprise Web Release: Headless 3D Coverflow Showcase Studio (8th Settings Tab), Hero/KPIs/Workstations Dynamic Management & REST Media Integration
highlights: 1. Dynamic 3D Coverflow Showcase Studio: Added dedicated 8th tab in Settings for live management of public 3D machinery coverflow workstations, precision specs, hero typography, and plant contact coordinates.
2. Binary Media File Uploader: Instant photographic upload with dynamic in-memory client previews, bounding limits, and server resource streaming.
3. Live Preview & Instant Cloud Publishing: One-click preview launching the interactive 3D showcase alongside atomic REST PUT publishing without server restarts.
